name: handoff
description: The mini Clippy beside the band above the prompt: calm / worried / panic by context fill, with random Ukrainian remarks; /handoff puts a HANDOFF.md/CONTEXT.md prompt into the input box (the hud band has its button). VS Code: a hint after the answer from 80%.

warnPercent.title: Colour the context amber from, percent
warnPercent.description: The context line is always shown; from this fill it turns amber (and red from handoffAtPercent).

handoffAtPercent.title: Offer handoff at, percent of context
handoffAtPercent.description: From this context fill a button (desktop), a hint line (terminal) or a hint after the answer (VS Code) offers /handoff.

remarkEverySeconds.title: Clippy random remark every, seconds
remarkEverySeconds.description: A short random phrase from the Clippy about this often (x0.5..1.5, shown for 9 s). 0: no random phrases.
